mapper.sql: SELECT tc.*, u.name AS author_name, ar.atomic_text, r.id AS requirement_id, r.req_code, op.name AS origin_project_name, rv.name AS reviewed_by_name FROM test_case tc LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = tc.author_id LEFT JOIN atomic_requirement ar ON ar.id = tc.atomic_requirement_id LEFT JOIN requirement r ON r.id = ar.requirement_id LEFT JOIN project op ON op.id = tc.origin_project_id LEFT JOIN users rv ON rv.id = tc.reviewed_by

mapper.select: SELECT j.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_step s WHERE s.test_case_id = j.id) AS step_count FROM ( ) j ORDER BY j.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO test_case (tc_code, title, module, precondition, priority, status, tags, source, technique, review_status, atomic_requirement_id, origin_project_id, author_id) VALUES ((SELECT CONCAT('TC-', LPAD(CAST(COALESCE(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(tc_code, 4) AS INT)), 0) + 1 AS VARCHAR), 5, '0')) FROM test_case WHERE tc_code LIKE 'TC-%'), #{title}, #{module}, #{precondition}, #{priority}, #{status}, #{tags}, #{source}, #{technique}, #{reviewStatus}, #{atomicRequirementId}, #{originProjectId}, #{authorId})
mapper.update: UPDATE test_case SET title = #{title}, module = #{module}, precondition = #{precondition}, priority = #{priority}, status = #{status}, tags = #{tags}, technique = #{technique}, atomic_requirement_id = #{atomicRequirementId}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE test_case SET review_status = #{reviewStatus}, reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
